loss.line: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.

withdrawal.line: ◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. NO HUNGER ON THE RECORD — THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE. NO FEAST, NO SURGE, NOTHING HERE WE CAN PRICE. A COLD SPOT AT EVERY TABLE: THE WORDS WERE ON THE WRAPPER." The ledger still wants: the food-thesis deeds (no feast can carry the surge while the pellet hums). The mantle may pass to hungrier hands; the table will still be here.
